name: Kaycee Industries Limited
about: Kaycee Industries Limited manufactures and trades in electrical installation products in India. The company operates in two segments: Manufacturing and Trading. It offers lugs rotary, toggle, limit, new cam, rotary toggle, timer, universal counter, PB and lamp, digi count, digital time totalizer, electrical and electronics measuring instruments, relays, submersible cables, earthing devices, wires and cables, fuse base and neutral links, current and voltage transformers, and control panels products, as well as micro, cam, and relay switches; and time, mini time products. The company also provides stroke counters, measuring machines, and senior revolution and road measure products, as well as rotary toggles and cable lugs. The company sells its products to the power, telecom, and renewables industries, as well as panel builders and machine tool manufacturers. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1942 and is based in Mumbai, India. Kaycee Industries Limited is a subsidiary of Salzer Electronics Limited.
